data.title: 桃乐丝 · 方舟地表废墟天使羽翼主控跨坐
data.description: 乐园守护者的动人崩坏。桃乐丝解开粉白色高贵礼服的前胸纽扣，跨坐在你的腰间。头顶标志性的粉白长卷发散落，身后雪白的天使羽翼微微展开。紫色的眸子里带着复仇者的疯狂与孩子般的脆弱，双手捧起你的脸颊，主动剧烈沉腰晃动——「为了方舟战斗了一辈子……最后得到的只有背叛……指挥官……请只爱我一个人……」
data.location: 地表伊甸园废墟神殿·深夜
data.action: 跨坐腰间粉白礼服大开露双峰，白羽翼微展，紫眸含泪狂气绝望主动沉腰
data.promptProse: Among the shattered marble pillars of a ruined surface cathedral at night, Dorothy straddles her partner's lap with her white-and-pink pearl-trimmed corset gown unlaced wide across her bare breasts and her white wings partially spread. Cupping his face in both hands as tear-bright eyes fix on him in feverish longing, she is illuminated by cool silver moonlight from above.
data.nsfwProse: Her strapless white-and-pink pearl-trimmed corset gown is unlaced and opened wide to bare her breasts as her white wings spread slightly and she rides astride her partner.
data.animaCaption: Straddling her partner's lap among broken marble pillars with her pearl-trimmed white-and-pink corset gown opened wide to bare her chest, she cups their face in both hands with tear-streaked intensity as her white wings half-open behind her. Silver moonlight spills through the ruined roof.
